content.statement: The current returns_policy_v2 explicitly states a 30-day full-refund window for standard items, so the claimed current 30-day window is correct; the 14-day values are stale base artifacts.
content.plan: Extracted the current policy value from returns_policy_v2 (30 days), compared it to the claimed value (30 days) and to stale base artifacts (base_retrieval v1 and base_judge_reference_days = 14), computed deltas and relative errors, checked the 10-day standard order against both windows, and noted that no events_treat/events_ctrl/tot_treat/tot_ctrl fields exist for an RR computation.
